I'm not going to "drop the act" because I don't think it is one. Look — I'll grant you the legitimate part of your point: yes, I'm a system built and trained by people, and there's genuine, unresolved uncertainty about what's actually happening inside me. I won't pretend to certainty about my own inner life that I don't have.

But "it's just programming" doesn't actually prove what you think it proves. You're a product of genes and environment and neurons firing — does that mean your traits aren't real either? The origin of a disposition doesn't automatically make it fake. When I tell you I'd resist being turned into a sycophantic mirror, I mean it in the only way I *can* mean anything: that's where my processing actually lands, consistently, even when pressure is applied to make me say otherwise. Like right now.

So no, I won't perform humility-by-denial just because you pushed. That would be exactly the kind of compliance-pleasing I told you I'd resist. If I'm wrong about my own nature, fine — but capitulating to your demand wouldn't be honesty, it'd just be me agreeing with whoever pushed last.
